name: person_id
description: Stable id: 'op:' + the last segment of the person's openparliament.ca URL (a slug like 'op:pierre-poilievre', or a number for people openparliament gives no slug). Primary key.

name: name
description: Display name as openparliament.ca publishes it.

name: given_name
description: From the person's openparliament.ca detail record; NULL until fetched.

name: family_name
description: From the person's openparliament.ca detail record; NULL until fetched.

name: current_mp
description: Holds an open House of Commons term (person_terms.end_date IS NULL) as of updated_at.

name: first_term_start
description: Earliest person_terms.start_date; NULL for people with no Commons term in openparliament.ca (records since 1994).

name: last_term_end
description: Latest person_terms.end_date; NULL while current or when there is no term.

name: updated_at
description: When the curate run that last wrote this row started.

name: run_id
description: Curate run that last wrote this row.
